name: SSHI_FBR_Zener
rationale: The reference FBR failed on low-voltage conditions (S2, S4) due to diode drops and on high-voltage conditions (S3) due to lack of clamping. To address this, I'm implementing a Parallel Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit. This uses an inductor (L1) and a switch (S1) to flip the voltage on the piezo capacitance at its extrema, effectively increasing the voltage available to the rectifier and improving efficiency. To prevent the output voltage from exceeding the 3.6V limit under light loads/strong excitation (S3), a 3.3V Zener diode (DZ1) is added as a clamp. The Full-Bridge Rectifier (FBR) is maintained to capture energy from both half-cycles of the piezo current.
